network_enforcement: The release checker runs each Lean process through Bubblewrap with an unshared network namespace, a read-only host filesystem, and only a disposable module directory writable. Host-side hash, Git, JSON, and authority checks make no network request. This is narrow nonrelease evidence, not the required clean empty-cache cold build or offline restoration.
scope_boundary: Fail-closed release reconciliation plus a current network-isolated trust-zero replay against existing pinned warm artifacts. It verifies the exact target surface, conditional composition, zero-dimensional body, same-worker differential probes, source hygiene, selected hashes, and the negative terminal decisions. It cannot accept the provisional validation dependency, prove the positive-dimensional Morse engine, reconcile accepted authority, establish H0/R0 or complete trust/provenance, repair the concurrently incomplete flt-regular package checkout, perform a cold/offline build, provide independent signed runners or a minimal verifier, assemble a deterministic release bundle, or establish AUDIT-Z/THEOREM-Z.
